_note: Chord Lab chord types (docs/chord-lab-prd.md L1): what pop-punk guitarists use, beyond power chords. Intervals in semitones from the root; `optional` intervals may be left out of a voicing (the 5th of the 7th chords). `symbol` follows the root in a chord name.

types.name: power chord
types.sounds: No 3rd, so it's neither happy nor sad: the genre's engine.

types.label: OCT
types.name: octave
types.sounds: Just the root, twice. Riffs, intros and lead lines.

types.label: MINOR
types.name: minor
types.sounds: Darker: the sad side of the key.

types.label: SUS4
types.name: suspended 4th
types.sounds: Hanging: it wants to fall back to the major.

types.label: ADD9
types.name: added 9th
types.sounds: Major with a sparkle on top.

types.name: dominant 7th
types.sounds: A bluesy pull towards the next chord.
